# Divide an estate's belongings between heirs fairly

> Free estate item divider for executors and families. Each heir privately values every item; the tool gives each item to whoever values it most and computes cash payments so no heir would swap piles (envy-free), or finds the fairest items-only division with no cash (maximum Nash welfare, envy-free up to one item). Unequal shares supported. Private, in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [How to divide personal property among heirs, with a worked example](https://marisstella.app/estate-item-divider/how-to-divide-personal-property-among-heirs.html)
